name: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA Hons.)
description: Undergraduate professional programme in Business Administration under Patna University, offered across prestigious colleges including Vanijya Mahavidyalaya (VMV) and B.N. College. Focuses on management principles, financial accounting, marketing, human resources, business law, and strategic operations.

papers.name: Principles of Management
recommendedBooks: Essentials of Management - Harold Koontz and Heinz Weihrich, McGraw Hill
Principles and Practice of Management - L.M. Prasad, Sultan Chand & Sons
Management - Stephen P. Robbins & Mary Coulter, Pearson

units.title: Nature & Evolution of Management
topics: Concept, nature, purpose and scope of management; Management as an art, science and profession
Management vs Administration; Levels and skills of management
Evolution of management thought: Classical theory (F.W. Taylor, Henri Fayol), Neo-classical (Elton Mayo Hawthorne experiments), Systems and Contingency approaches

units.title: Planning & Decision Making
topics: Concept, importance, types and steps in planning; Strategic vs Operational planning
Management by Objectives (MBO): Process and benefits
Decision making: Nature, types, rational decision making process, techniques and bounded rationality

units.title: Organizing & Staffing
topics: Nature, process and principles of organizing; Formal and informal organization
Organizational structures: Line, functional, matrix and project structures
Span of control, centralization vs decentralization, delegation of authority
Staffing: Meaning, importance, manpower planning, recruitment and selection basics

units.title: Directing, Leading & Controlling
topics: Directing: Principles, motivation theories (Maslow, Herzberg, McGregor Theory X & Y)
Leadership: Concept, styles (Autocratic, Democratic, Free-rein), managerial grid
Communication: Channels, barriers and effective business communication
Controlling: Meaning, process, types, budgetary control and modern control techniques

units.title: Demand Analysis & Elasticity

Demand forecasting: Purpose, qualitative and quantitative forecasting methods

units.title: Production & Cost Analysis

units.title: Market Structures & Pricing

Monopoly: Equilibrium, price discrimination and regulation
